metrics.label: Typical download speed
metrics.help: Middle value of speed tests in the region: half of tests were faster, half slower.

metrics.label: Download speed, slower end
metrics.help: A quarter of tests were slower than this. Shows what the worse-served users get.

metrics.label: Typical response delay
metrics.help: Round-trip delay. Lower is better; high delay hurts video calls and live lessons.

metrics.label: Synthetic school 30-day median download
metrics.help: Median of per-school 30-day download medians for metered schools. Synthetic placeholders; blank below the minimum sample size.

metrics.label: Synthetic metered schools below 1 Mbps
metrics.help: Share of recently metered schools with median download below 1 Mbps. Synthetic placeholders; blank below the minimum sample size.

metrics.label: Synthetic schools with recent meter data
metrics.help: Share of located schools with recent meter data. This is coverage, not connectivity quality; all values are synthetic placeholders.

metrics.label: Synthetic reported-connected schools below 1 Mbps
metrics.help: Among recently metered schools reported as connected, share with median download below 1 Mbps. Synthetic placeholders; blank below the minimum sample size.

caveats: Speeds come from voluntary internet speed tests by the general public, not from schools. They describe regions, not individual schools, and tests are not a random sample of users.
Hatched regions have few tests (under the minimum sample size), so their figures are unreliable.
Grey regions have no usable data this period, or could not be matched to a boundary with confidence.
Region boundaries and names can change over time; a few regions may be matched approximately.
